job.question: In the Los Angeles City Employees' Retirement System (LACERS) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the lead actuary have?
job.expected_facts: At least 15 years of experience with major public employee retirement systems, including at least 3 years with California public pension fund clients similar to LACERS.
job.acceptance: Accept 15 total and three California years. Do not require credential details unrelated to the years asked.

reviews.reason: This is an OCERS pension administration system consulting RFP, not the LACERS actuarial RFP. Its five-year requirement concerns a primary consultant on a different project; it does not establish the lead actuary’s experience requirement or the California-client component.
quotes: Pension Administration Project Oversight and Consultation Services Request for Proposal September 2023 Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS)
Primary consultant performing the work must have a minimum of five (5) years of similar project experience as a consultant with a public defined benefit pension system.
